jobs.title: Marketing Product Manager
jobs.description:
Tempur Sealy. Iconic brands. Storied history. Industry-leading innovation.

Tempur Sealy is committed to improving the sleep of more people, every night, all around the world. As a leading designer, manufacturer, distributor, and retailer of bedding products worldwide, we know how crucial a good night of sleep is to overall health and wellness. Utilizing over a century of knowledge and industry-leading innovation, we deliver award-winning products that provide breakthrough sleep solutions to consumers in over 100 countries. Our highly recognized brands include Tempur-Pedic®, Sealy® and Stearns & Foster®. We hire people who have a passion for helping others find their best night’s sleep. No matter what stage of your career, you can build your future at Tempur Sealy!

OUR COMPANY OFFERS GREAT BENEFITS, INCLUDING:
- Generous Paid Time Off

- Competitive Medical, Dental & other wellness programs

- Disability and Life Company Paid

- Retirement Plan Options

- Generous Employee Purchase Discounts

Pay Range: $50,000-$71,000

What You’ll Do (Essential Duties and Responsibilities):
- Drive performance marketing campaign production, and ensure test design, messaging and targeting across Performance Marketing channels is consistent and on-strategy

- Lead daily communication work- flows – messaging strategy, creative brief, campaign specifications, timelines, testing and deployment

- Manage and maintain a performance marketing KPI forecast, and be accountable for delivering continuously improving business KPIs for each brand

- Through robust campaign and market analysis, identify consumer trends and opportunities to continuously increase business KPIs, Return-On-Ad-Spend (ROAS) and engagement

- Collaborate with a variety of internal and external partners to ensure messaging and promotion details are aligned with cross-functional teams

- Handle operational details in a ‘roll up your sleeves’ way

- Quality assurance for all Performance Digital campaigns

- Proactively problem solve and identify campaign and business opportunities to innovate, reduce complexity and drive results

- Perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need (Qualifications):
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience (required)

- 2 + years real-life experience analyzing and driving revenue generating business outcome (preferred)

- 1+ years of working experience in Google Ads and/or Facebook Business Manager, and experience working in web analytics software (Google Analytics, Adobe, etc.)

- Proven expertise in using Microsoft Excel to perform frequent business and campaign marketing analysis (required)
